question:
Which drivers who were born in 1971 and has the fastest lap time on the race? Give id and code of these drivers.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: born in 1971 refers to year(dob) = 1971; has the fastest lap time refers to fastestLapTime has values

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_034, d.XCL_037
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
WHERE substr(d.XCL_040, 1, 4) = '1971'
  AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
  AND r.XCL_088 != ''

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.XCL_034 AS id,
    d.XCL_037 AS code
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
WHERE
    d.XCL_040 LIKE '1971%'
    AND lt.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
    AND lt.XCL_047 = (
        SELECT MIN(lt2.XCL_047)
        FROM lapTimes lt2
        WHERE lt2.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
    )
